scope: the measured coverage holes of the 28-volume / 721-cluster run: vascular endothelium in retina and choroid, macrophage and monocyte separated from microglia, retinal rod depth, and the RPE/melanocyte pair
status: staging only; library `holefill_v12` is NOT merged into the default `all` set and has no whitelist entry, so the default route is byte-identical in every state
scope_tissues_provenance: The tissues are the measured holes' own range: every author label these entries carry occurs in the recorded volumes declared under one of them (endothelium across retina/choroid/optic nerve/ciliary body/iris/cornea/conjunctiva/sclera; macrophage and monocyte across the uveal and anterior-segment volumes; rod and RPE in retina/RPE/choroid). The range is read from the volumes' own declarations and is NOT confirmed by a source independent of this wave's effect data; narrowing it needs such a source.

entries.cl_overlap_note: CL:0000115 is the term of the shipped membrane-library entry `Endo` (13 genes). This entry is the same cell under the ontology label the volumes use, with a deeper pan-vascular panel and coverage of the arterial/venous/arteriolar/fenestrated partitions; the membrane body is untouched. The two entries differ in name, so no ranking carries one class twice.

build_warnings: Development-set filtering: panels were validated on the volumes they are reported on. Readings in this file are feasibility readings, not held-out performance.

Two entries fail the pre-registered cov_ge3 >= 0.90 bar (classical monocyte, non-classical monocyte) and are recorded as FAIL, not claimed: their corpus support is 13 and 9 papers. They are kept because the subtype-affordability question is answered by them, and the library is not activated.

The identity stage ranks by paper support, which admits ubiquitous symbols (for example GAPDH, SOD1). Their per-gene ratio is reported in the plan directory's panels_built.json; the merged-arm harm line is the place where the cost shows.
